verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              ततः शान्तनवो भीष्मो दुर्योधनममर्षणम्। केशवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रोवाच भरतर्षम ॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Then did the son of Shantanu, Bhishma, say to the wrathful Duryodhana, hearing the words of Keshava, O you best among the Bharata.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णेन वाक्यमुक्तोऽसि सुहृदां शममिच्छता। अन्वपद्यस्व तत्तात मा मन्युवशमन्वगाः ॥२॥
verses.english: “By Krishna has been spoken the words of a friend wishing for peace; listen to that my dear son, and do not follow the lead if vindictiveness.

verses.sanskrit: अकृत्वा वचनं तात केशवस्य महात्मनः। श्रेयो न जातु न सुखं न कल्याणमवाप्स्यसि ॥३॥
verses.english: By not acting up to the words of the great souled Keshava, will you not be able to obtain prosperity nor happiness nor your good.

verses.sanskrit: धर्म्यमर्थ्यं महाबाहुराह त्वां तात केशवः। तदर्थमभिपद्यस्व मा राजन्नीनशः प्रजाः ॥४॥
verses.english: The one of long arms, Keshava, has told you, my dear son, what will lead to virtue and to the obtainment of earthly good; and may you obtain that object, О king; do not destroy these living creatures.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वलितां त्वमिमां लक्ष्मीं भारतीं सर्वराजसु। जीवतो धृतराष्ट्रस्य दौरात्म्याद्भ्रंशयिष्यसि ॥५॥
verses.english: Do not by your wicked deeds cause to break down this blazing prosperity of the Bharatas, among all kings while Dhritarashtra is alive.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानं च सहामात्यं सपुत्रभ्रातृबान्धवम्। अहमित्यनया बुद्ध्या जीविताद्भ्रंशयिष्यसि ॥६॥
verses.english: Yourself with your ministers and with your sons, brothers and friends will be deprived of lives by your way-wardness and obstinacy.

verses.sanskrit: अतिक्रामन् केशवस्य तथ्यं वचनमर्थवत्। पितुश्च भरतश्रेष्ठ विदुरस्य च धीमतः ॥७॥
verses.english: By acting against the beneficial advice leading to the obtainment of earthly benefit of Keshava as also of your father and the wise Vidura, O foremost among the Bharatas,

verses.sanskrit: मा कुलघ्नः कुपुरुषो दुर्मतिः कापथं गमः। मातरं पितरं चैष मा मज्जीः शोकसागरे ॥८॥
verses.english: Do not bring about the extermination of your race; do not act like a wicked man of evil intellect and do not follow a wrong course. Do not drown your father and your mother in a sea of grief."

verses.sanskrit: अथ द्रोणोऽब्रवीत्तत्र दुर्योधनामदं वचः। अमर्षवशमापन्नं निःश्वसन्तं पुनःपुनः ॥९॥
verses.english: Then did Drona say these words to Duryodhana there who was under the influence of wrath and breathing hard again and again.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मार्थयुक्तं वचनमाह त्वां तात केशवः। तथा भीष्मः शान्तनवस्तज्जुषस्व नराधिप ॥१०॥
verses.english: “Keshava said words to you which are pregnant with virtue and profit, my dear son,; so did Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, O ruler of men, accept them.

verses.sanskrit: प्राज्ञौ मेधाविनौ दान्तावर्थकामौ बहुश्रुतौ। आहतुस्त्वां हितं वाक्यं तज्जुषस्व नराधिप ॥११॥
verses.english: The two are wise, have intelligence, have their souls under control, know what leads to are, as virtue and to worldly good and they are vastly learned; they have told you beneficial words; O ruler of men, accept them.

verses.sanskrit: अनुतिष्ठ महाप्राज्ञ कृष्णभीष्मौ यदूचतुः। माधवं बुद्धिमोहेन माऽवमंस्थाः परंतप ॥१२॥
verses.english: Follow, O greatly wise man, what the two, Krishna and Bhishma have said; do not from perverted understanding insult Madhava, O chastiser of foes.

verses.sanskrit: ये त्वां प्रोत्साहयन्त्येते नैते कृत्याय कार्हिचित्। वैरं परेषां ग्रीवायां प्रतिमोक्ष्यन्ति संयुगे ॥१३॥
verses.english: Those, who are now encouraging and supporting you, will hardly do any thing when the time comes; and they rather will throw the (act of bearing) hostilities on the shoulders of others.

verses.sanskrit: मा जीघनः प्रजाः सर्वाः पुत्रान् भ्रातॄंस्तथैव च। वासुदेवार्जुनौ यत्र विद्ध्यजेयानलं हि तान् ॥१४॥
verses.english: Do not slay all these living creatures as also your sons and brothers; the side on which Vasudeva and Arjuna know unconquerable and invisible.

verses.sanskrit: एतच्चैव मतं सत्यं सुहृदोः कृष्णभीष्मयोः। यदि नादास्यसे तात पश्चात्तप्स्यसि भारत ॥१५॥
verses.english: This is truly the opinion of your friend Krishna, and if you do not accept that, my dear son, you will grieve for it in the end, O Bharata,
verses.bhavadeepa: मा जीघनः मा घातय । यत्र तान् अजेयान् विद्धि ॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: यथोक्तं जामदग्न्येन भूयानेष ततोऽर्जुनः। कृष्णो हि देवकीपुत्रो देवैरपि सुदुःसहः। किं ते सुखप्रियेणेह प्रोक्तेन भरतर्षभ ॥१६॥
verses.english: Arjuna is still mightier than what the son of Jamadagni has described him to be; Krishna, the son of Devaki, is hard to vanquished even by gods, O best among the Bharatas, what is the use of telling you what is conducive to your happiness and ought therefore to be desired for by you.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु। न हि त्वामुत्सहे वक्तुं भूयो भरतसत्तम ॥१७॥
verses.english: All this is described to you; do as you like; I do not wish to address you more, O best among the Bharatas.
verses.bhavadeepa: सुखं हितावहं प्रियं च न्यायोपेतत्वात् तेन सुखप्रियेण प्रोक्तेन वचनेन तव मूढस्य किं न किमपीत्यर्थः ॥१६॥

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              तस्मिन्वाक्यान्तरे वाक्यं क्षत्तापि विदुरोऽब्रवीत्। दुर्योधनमभिप्रेक्ष्य धार्तराष्ट्रममर्षणम् ॥१८॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said At the end of that speech did Kshattri Vidura also speak words looking at the wrathful son of Dhritarashtra, Duryodhana.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधन न शोचामि त्वामहं भरतर्षभ। इमौ तु वृद्धी शोचामि गान्धारीं पितरं च ते ॥१९॥
verses.english: 'Duryodhana, I do not grieve for you, O best among the Bharatas; I grieve for these two old people namely your father and Gandhari (your mother).

verses.sanskrit: यावानर्थौ चरिष्येते त्वया नाथेन दुर्हृदा। हतमित्रौ हतामात्यौ लूनपक्षाविवाण्डजौ ॥२०॥
verses.english: Having yourself of wicked heart as their protector, they will wander about without any one (in a short time) with their friends slain and with ministers killed, like those born of eggs deprived of their wings.

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षुकौ विचरिष्येत शोचन्तौ पृथिवीमिमाम्। कुलघ्नमीदृशं पापं जनयित्वा कुपूरुषम् ॥२१॥
verses.english: Grieving, they will wander about as beggars on the earth, having begotten such a wicked and vicious man, the exterminator of his race.

verses.sanskrit: अथ दुर्योधनं राजा धृतराष्ट्रोऽभ्यभाषत। आसीनं भ्रातृभिः सार्धं राजभिः परिवारितम् ॥२२॥
verses.english: Then the king Dhritarashtra said to Duryodhana who was seated along with his brothers and surrounded by other kings,

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधन निबोधेदं शौरिणोक्तं महात्मना। आदत्स्व शिवमत्यन्तं योगक्षेमवदव्ययम् ॥२३॥
verses.english: "O Duryodhana, listen to this alive given by the great-souled Shouri; accept his words which are true, most beneficial, and conducive to our salvation.

verses.sanskrit: अनेन हि सहायेन कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। इष्टान् सर्वानभिप्रायान् प्राप्स्यामः सर्वराजसु ॥२४॥
verses.english: By the help of namely of Krishna of unblamable acts, we, of all other kings, shall obtain all desirable

verses.sanskrit: सुसंहतः केशवेन तात गच्छ युधिष्ठिरम्। चर स्वस्त्ययनं कृत्स्नं भरतानामनामयम् ॥२५॥
verses.english: being well united with Keshava, my dear son, go to Yudhishthira and make arrangements for a ceremony for the good of the Bharatas (the Pandavas and Kurus united together).

verses.sanskrit: वासुदेवेन तीर्थेन तात गच्छस्व संशमम्। कालप्राप्तमिदं मन्ये मा त्वं दुर्योधनातिगाः ॥२६॥
verses.english: By the help if Vasudeva, make peace (with the Pandavas); I think the proper time has now arrived; O Dhritarashtra, do not disobey me.

verses.sanskrit: शमं चेद्याचमानं त्वं प्रत्याख्यास्यसि केशवम्। त्वदर्थमभिजल्पन्तं न तवास्त्यपराभवः ॥२७॥
verses.english: If you abandon peace which is begged from you for the accomplishment of your own good, then will victory never be yours."
